title: cast.json (the cast of one show)
description: out/<show>/cast.json. One entry per character; the key is the character's own name. Scripts use only these keys; the renderer picks voices from `gender`.

key.description: role key = the character's own name in lowercase Latin (max, barinov, kostya, nastya). Never a viewpoint/protagonist slot (anya, lea, lead, hero ...).

ru.description: display name in the show's language, exactly as used in `labels` of every script (fr shows: the French display name).

en.description: names the English narration may use for this character. First = the canonical form. Include accepted short forms, e.g. ["Max","Maksim","Lavrov","Maksim Lavrov"] or ["Barinov","Viktor","Chef","Viktor Barinov"]. A form may be several words; each word is accepted on its own.

gender.description: drives the voice (renderer) and grammar agreement in the character's lines.

other_names.description: Optional. Non-character proper nouns the English narration may use (restaurants, places, teams): ["Claude Monet", "Arcobaleno", "Voronezh"]. Any other capitalised name that is neither here nor a character is an error.
